primary.panels: four distinct TARGETs, same START, exactly one solution per TARGET
primary.checkpoint: fixed final training checkpoint; never choose best dev/final B or D
primary.correction: none; row/column offsets cancel in the primary contrast

secondary: raw and corrected H(K) for every K; H1/H8/H32, MRR, correct mass
all three wrong TARGET donors and SFT-minus-atomic change in own-target advantage
minus-bias-only, train frequency, anti-frequency, unseen-first, shuffled program bias
A and C separately and fixed equal A/B/C/D mixture
pooled unigram vs positional unigram vs pooled bigram vs positional+bigram at d3
pooled unigram and bigram transfer d3 to d4; no positional or full-table transfer

ties.model_scores: canonical lexical, matching the historical evaluator
ties.frequency_controls: exact expectation over uniformly random fixed ranking within ties; without replacement, not IID pass@K

phases.final: explicit immutable analysis lock, separate final atomic/tasks/panels; no automatic final after dev

statistics.primary_unit: START cluster, paired arms on identical panels
statistics.bootstrap: 2000 fixed-seed resamples within B and D, average continuation seeds first; report per-seed estimates too
statistics.mask_level: report each of four masks separately and their equal mean; tasks do not replace independent masks
statistics.shared_initialization: all Qwen continuations share the inherited atomic checkpoint; not independent atomic pretraining seeds
statistics.selection: primary contrast fixed here; secondary results exploratory, never optimize on final

atomic_competence.when: baseline on each dataset before composition training
atomic_competence.failure: continue distribution diagnostics, but do not claim composition of reliably acquired atomic skills

stages.01: old q06 checkpoints dev, then identical locked analysis on q8b; zero new training
stages.02_pilot: mask1 and mask2, atomic_control and composition, seed0: four training jobs
stages.02_remaining: mask3/4 seed0 and all four masks seed1: twelve additional training jobs, explicit opt-in after interpreting 01 and pilot
stages.04: redesigned multi-solution pool; fixed vs balanced seed0 first, two training jobs
stages.03: deferred: old triple/position collapse to 1/4 answers; require multiple held patterns, constituent-pair exposure and four-target panels before scheduling
stages.05: deferred: define gradient hypothesis; MC vs exact at one fixed checkpoint, actual score/parameter delta, BF16 vs FP32 before any full reward run
stages.06: conditional: central contrast and fixed/balanced intervention only; no automatic full sweep

witness_preflight.manipulation: balanced must reduce aggregate squared adjacent-pair counts and alter actual labels; report position/unigram/program entropy separately; not a diversity-maximization claim
